title: S01 Single Basin Cabinet
description: Version 2 of the original sink-cabinet function, now in the S01 freestanding furniture family. Nominal width changes from0.70m to0.60m; nominal counter depth0.60m and height0.90m. Thick real basin cavity, downward spout outlet recess, simple control lever and recessed drain cap. Independent left door node with finite tested poses; no water flow, pipe or continuous mechanical simulation. Individual complete top, not a seamless fitted-kitchen module. This is a version upgrade, not a new unique asset type. Independent editable hinge node and the finite tested poses recorded in door_motion; no animation, continuous-motion, load or physics claim.
